name: android-caffeine-tracker
description: An Android app that logs your coffee, tea and energy drinks and estimates how much caffeine is still active in your body and when it will drop low enough for sleep.

name: android-habit-streaks
description: An Android app that lists your daily habits with current and best streaks, a seven-day dot strip per habit, and a one-tap check-in for today.

name: android-countdown
description: An Android app that shows live days/hours/minutes/seconds countdowns to your upcoming events, with past events listed below.

name: android-qr-generator

name: android-password-generator

name: android-water-intake-log
description: A single-screen Android app that logs drinks against a daily water goal and shows progress with a running total.

name: android-pomodoro-timer
description: A single-screen Android Pomodoro timer: pick a preset, run alternating focus/break countdowns, and track completed sessions.

name: androidlib-compose-shimmer
description: An Android library of Jetpack Compose skeleton loaders: a `shimmer()` modifier, a `skeleton()` placeholder modifier, and ready-made list-row placeholders.

name: androidlib-pii-redaction-log
description: An Android logging wrapper that scrubs emails, Indonesian phone numbers, NIK, card numbers, tokens and `password=...` pairs from every message and stack trace before it reaches logcat (or any sink you plug in).

name: androidlib-crash-breadcrumbs
description: An Android library that keeps a ring buffer of the last N things your app did and writes them next to the stack trace when the app crashes, so the next launch can show what the user did before it died.

name: androidlib-id-formatters
description: A dependency-free Kotlin library that formats and parses Rupiah, normalises Indonesian mobile numbers, and structurally validates NIK (national ID) numbers.

name: ios-plant-watering
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app that lists your houseplants by urgency, shows which are overdue or due today, and lets you mark one watered with a tap.

name: ios-mood-log
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app where you pick today's mood and a short note, and see your average, current streak, best day and history.

name: ios-checklist
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app that loads starter checklists (trip, moving day, leaving the house), lets you tick items off with a progress bar, and add, delete or reset items.

name: ios-tip-calculator
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app that suggests a tip for the country you are eating in, then splits the total between diners down to the cent.

name: ios-sleep-log
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app that shows the last week of sleep as a bar-per-night log with an average, and lets you log tonight's hours and quality.

name: ios-packing-list
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app that groups a trip's packing items by category (Clothing, Toiletries, Electronics, Documents) and lets you check each one off, with a progress bar showing how much is packed.

name: ios-habit-tracker
description: A single-screen SwiftUI app that lists daily habits, shows each one's streak and last-7-day history, and lets you check it off for today.

name: kmpfullstack-note-store
description: A pinned-notes app where every note lives on one Ktor server and shows up, with the same search and pin-first ordering, in the Android, web and iOS clients: one Kotlin domain in `shared/`, four front ends.

name: kmpfullstack-habit-sync
description: A habit tracker where every check-in lives on one Ktor server and shows up, with the same streak maths, in the Android, web and iOS clients: one Kotlin domain in `shared/`, four front ends.

name: kmpfullstack-shopping-list
description: A shopping list you can tick off, filter by aisle and clear once you are at the till: one Kotlin domain in `shared/`, a Ktor API in `server/`, and Android, web and iOS clients that all talk to it.

name: kmpfullstack-bookmark-store
description: A tagged bookmark manager with starring and deletion: one Kotlin domain in `shared/`, a Ktor API in `server/`, and Android, web and iOS clients that all talk to it.

name: kmpfullstack-short-link-service
description: A URL shortener: paste a long URL to get a short code back, visiting `/r/<code>` redirects to the original URL and counts the click — with the model, validation, and short-code logic defined once in a Kotlin Multiplatform `shared` module and used by a real Ktor server plus three clients (Android, iOS, web) that all talk to it over HTTP.

name: kmp-grocery-list
description: A Kotlin Multiplatform grocery list: adding items, checking them off, grouping by aisle category, and tracking cart progress all live in a `shared` module, with a Jetpack Compose screen on Android that lists the fixture grouped by category with a progress bar and an add-item row.

name: kmp-unit-converter
description: A Kotlin Multiplatform unit converter: category selection, unit lookup, and the conversion math live in a `shared` module, with a Jetpack Compose screen on Android that lets you pick a category, choose From/To units, and see the live result.

name: kmp-reading-tracker
description: A Kotlin Multiplatform reading tracker: the book list, progress math, and state management live in a `shared` module, with a Jetpack Compose screen on Android that lists books, shows read-progress bars, and lets you log pages.

name: web-meeting-planner
description: A Nuxt 4 single-page tool that lays cities' working hours side by side and highlights the hours when everyone is at work, so you can pick a meeting time.

name: web-meal-planner
description: A Vue 3 page where you choose a dinner for each day of the week and get a merged shopping list and calorie total automatically.

name: web-image-compressor
description: A browser tool that shrinks an image by re-encoding it as JPEG, WebP or PNG at a chosen quality and width, and shows the before/after file sizes side by side.

name: web-markdown-scratchpad
description: A two-pane notes app: write Markdown on the left, see it rendered live on the right, with search and autosave.

name: web-receipt-scanner
description: A single-screen Vue app that runs mock OCR on a picked receipt photo, itemizes it, flags low-confidence lines, and recalculates the total as you correct them.

name: web-currency-converter
description: A single-screen React app that converts an amount between currencies using fixture exchange rates, with a full rate table shown below.

name: backend-packing-list
description: A small TypeScript (Hono) backend that generates a packing list for a trip from a template, scaling clothes by trip length, and tracks what has been packed.

name: backend-currency-converter
description: A small Go HTTP API that converts amounts between currencies using a rate table read from a local fixture, rounding results to each currency's minor units.

name: backend-sleep-log
description: A small Rust (Axum) service that records nightly sleep, computes duration across midnight, and summarises a window of nights with average sleep, sleep debt against an 8-hour goal, and bedtime regularity.

name: backend-reminder-api
description: A small FastAPI service for creating reminders, listing them by status (upcoming / overdue / done), and asking what is due in the next N hours.

name: backend-shift-planner
description: A small TypeScript backend that manages a workplace shift schedule: list open shifts, assign an employee, and get rejected with a clear reason when the role doesn't match or the employee is already booked at that time.

name: backend-expense-splitter
description: A small Go backend that tracks shared group expenses and tells you the minimal set of payments needed to settle up.

name: freelance-leave-tracker
description: A manager's leave-approval screen: a queue of pending requests with balance and team-conflict warnings, a month calendar of who is off, and per-employee leave balances.

name: freelance-mart-pos
description: A Vue 3 point-of-sale screen for a small mini-mart: tap or scan products into a cart, take cash with quick-cash buttons, and print an 80 mm receipt with PPN 11% and Rp 100 cash rounding.

name: freelance-order-board
description: A React kitchen order board for a small restaurant: orders move across New → Preparing → Ready → Served columns with one tap, late tickets are flagged by age, and staff can search by table, order number or dish.

name: freelance-stock-alerts
description: A Vue 3 stock screen for a small shop: it flags low and out-of-stock items, lets staff sell, add or receive stock, and builds a suggested supplier reorder list with an estimated cost.

name: freelance-invoice-generator
description: A single-screen React app where a freelancer picks a client, edits line items, and downloads a formatted PDF invoice with tax and totals calculated automatically.
